sentences.en: HELEN: I've brought my notes on our Biology Field Trip to Rocky Bay, Colin, so we can work on our report on the research we did together
sentences.zh: HELEN: 我带来了我们去罗基湾（Rocky Bay）进行生物学野外考察的笔记，科林，这样我们就能一起完成我们共同开展的研究报告了。

sentences.en: COLIN: OK
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好的。

sentences.en: I've got mine too
sentences.zh: 我也带了我的笔记。

sentences.en: Let's look at the aims of the trip first
sentences.zh: 我们先来看一下这次野外考察的目标吧。

sentences.en: HELEN: Right
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: What did you have?
sentences.zh: 你写了什么？

sentences.en: COLIN: I just put something about getting experience of the different sorts of procedures used on a field trip
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我只简单提到了积累野外考察中各类操作程序的实际经验。

sentences.en: But we need something about what causes different organisms to choose particular habitats
sentences.zh: 但我们还需要补充一点：不同生物选择特定栖息地的原因。

sentences.en: HELEN: I agree
sentences.zh: HELEN: 我同意。

sentences.en: And something about finding out how to protect organisms in danger of dying out?
sentences.zh: 另外，是否还要加上‘了解如何保护濒临灭绝的生物’这一条？

sentences.en: COLIN: In our aims?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 这要写进我们的考察目标里吗？

sentences.en: But we weren't really looking at that
sentences.zh: 但我们实际上并没有关注这方面。

sentences.en: HELEN: I suppose not
sentences.zh: HELEN: 想想确实没有。

sentences.en: OK, now there's the list of equipment we all had to bring on the field trip
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来是野外考察要求我们携带的设备清单。

sentences.en: What did they tell us to bring a ruler for?
sentences.zh: 他们让我们带尺子是做什么用的？

sentences.en: COLIN: It was something about measuring the slope of the shore, but of course we didn't need it because we were measuring wind direction, and we'd brought the compass for that
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好像是用来测量海岸坡度的，但其实我们根本没用上，因为我们测的是风向，而为此我们已带了指南针。

sentences.en: HELEN: But not the piece of string to hold up in the air!
sentences.zh: HELEN: 但没带那根用来悬在空中的细绳！

sentences.en: Didn't Mr Blake make a fuss about us leaving that behind
sentences.zh: 布莱克先生不是还因为这事责备我们忘带了吗？

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是啊。

sentences.en: He does go on
sentences.zh: 他确实爱唠叨。

sentences.en: Anyway it was easy to get one from another of the students
sentences.zh: 不过，后来从另一位同学那儿很容易就借到了一根。

sentences.en: HELEN: Now, the next section's the procedure. sent you the draft of that
sentences.zh: HELEN: 接下来是‘步骤’部分。我之前已把这部分的初稿发给你了。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对。

sentences.en: It was clear, but I don't think we need all these details of what time we left and what time we got back and how we divided up the different research tasks
sentences.zh: 内容很清晰，但我认为没必要详述我们出发和返回的具体时间，以及我们如何分配各项研究任务。

sentences.en: HELEN: OK
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll look at that again
sentences.zh: 我再重新看一下这部分。

sentences.en: COLIN: Then we have to describe our method of investigation in detail
sentences.zh: COLIN: 然后，我们必须详细描述我们的调查方法。

sentences.en: So let's begin with how we measured wave speed
sentences.zh: 那么我们先从如何测量波速说起吧。

sentences.en: I was surprised how straightforward that was
sentences.zh: 我惊讶于这个操作竟如此简单直接。

sentences.en: HELEN: I'd expected us to have some sort of high-tech device, not just stand there and count the number of waves per minute
sentences.zh: HELEN: 我原本以为会用到某种高科技设备，没想到只是站在那儿，数一分钟内经过的波浪数量。

sentences.en: Not very precise, but I suppose it was good enough
sentences.zh: 这方法不太精确，不过我想也足够用了。

sentences.en: But the way we measured the amount of salt was interesting
sentences.zh: 但测量盐分含量的方法倒挺有意思。

sentences.en: COLIN: In the water from the rock pools?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是指从岩池中取来的水样吗？

sentences.en: HELEN: Yeah, oh, I wanted to check the chemicals we used in the lab when we analysed those samples - was it potassium chromate and silver nitrate?
sentences.zh: HELEN: 对。哦，我还想确认一下我们在实验室分析这些样本时所用的化学试剂——是重铬酸钾和硝酸银吗？

sentences.en: COLIN: That's right
sentences.zh: COLIN: 没错。

sentences.en: HELEN: OK
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: And we need the map of the seashore
sentences.zh: 另外，我们还需要一张海岸线地图。

sentences.en: You just left that to me
sentences.zh: 这部分你全交给我负责了。

sentences.en: And I had to do it while the tide was low, well that was OK, but the place I started it from was down on the beach, then I realised I should have gone up higher to get better visibility, so had to start all over again
sentences.zh: 我是在退潮时绘制的，这倒没问题；但一开始我选的起点在海滩上，后来才意识到应该站得更高些，视野才更好，结果只好全部重画。

sentences.en: But at least I'd got the squared paper or I'd have had problems drawing it all to scale
sentences.zh: 不过幸好我带了方格纸，否则按比例绘图就会出问题了。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yes
sentences.zh: COLIN: 是的。

sentences.en: It looks good
sentences.zh: 看起来不错。

sentences.en: We could get a map of the region off the internet and see if we need to make any changes
sentences.zh: 我们可以上网找一张该地区的地图，看看是否需要做任何修改。

sentences.en: HELEN: had a look a but couldn't find anything
sentences.zh: HELEN: 我之前查过，但没找到什么有用的信息。

sentences.en: But you took some pictures, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 但你拍了一些照片，对吧？

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对。

sentences.en: I'll email you them if you want
sentences.zh: 如果你需要的话，我发邮件把照片发给你。

sentences.en: HELEN: OK
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll make my amendments using those, then I can scan it into our report
sentences.zh: 我就用这些照片来做我的修改，然后把修改后的版本扫描进我们的报告里。

sentences.en: Great
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: HELEN: Now when we get to our findings I thought we could divide them up into the different zones we identified on the shore and the problems organisms face in each zone
sentences.zh: HELEN: 接下来谈到我们的研究发现时，我想我们可以按我们在海岸上划分出的不同区域来分类，并分别讨论每个区域内生物所面临的各种问题。

sentences.en: So for the highest area
sentences.zh: 所以对于最高区域——

sentences.en: COLIN: the splash zone?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 溅浪带？

sentences.en: HELEN: Yeah, we found mostly those tiny shellfish that have strong hard shells that act as protection
sentences.zh: HELEN: 对，我们在那里主要发现了那些具有坚硬厚实外壳的微小贝类，这种外壳起着保护作用。

sentences.en: COLIN: But not from other organisms that might eat them, predators?
sentences.zh: COLIN: 但这并非为了抵御可能捕食它们的其他生物，即天敌？

sentences.en: HELEN: No, that's not the main danger for them
sentences.zh: HELEN: 不是，这对它们而言并非主要威胁。

sentences.en: But the shells prevent them from drying out. because they're in the open air for most of the time
sentences.zh: 但这些外壳能防止它们干枯脱水，因为它们大部分时间都暴露在空气中。

sentences.en: COLIN: Right
sentences.zh: COLIN: 明白了。

sentences.en: And since they're exposed, they need to be able to find some sort of shelter, or cover themselves up, so they don't get too hot
sentences.zh: 而且由于它们暴露在外，必须能够找到某种遮蔽物，或自行掩藏起来，以免过热。

sentences.en: Then in the middle and lower zones, nearer the sea, we need to discuss the effects of wave action
sentences.zh: 接着，在中潮带和低潮带——也就是更靠近大海的区域——我们需要讨论波浪作用的影响。

sentences.en: HELEN: Yes, and how organisms develop structures to prevent themselves from being swept away, or even destroyed by being smashed against the rocks
sentences.zh: HELEN: 对，还要讨论生物如何演化出特定结构，以防止自己被海浪冲走，甚至避免因撞击岩石而遭到破坏。

sentences.en: COLIN: I haven't done anything on the geological changes
sentences.zh: COLIN: 我还没整理过地质变化方面的内容。

sentences.en: I don't know what to put for that
sentences.zh: 我不知道这部分该写些什么。

sentences.en: HELEN: No, we weren't concentrating on that
sentences.zh: HELEN: 是的，我们原本就没把重点放在这上面。

sentences.en: Maybe we need to find some websites
sentences.zh: 也许我们需要找一些相关网站。

sentences.en: COLIN: Good idea
sentences.zh: COLIN: 好主意。

sentences.en: I've got the lecture notes from Mr Blake's geology course, but they're too general
sentences.zh: 我手头有布莱克先生地质学课程的讲义，但内容太笼统了。

sentences.en: But we could ask him which books on our Reading List might be most helpful
sentences.zh: 不过我们可以请教他，看看阅读清单上的哪些书籍对我们最有帮助。

sentences.en: HELEN: Right. a OK, now I did a draft of the section of sources of possible error in our research, but don't know if you agree
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。嗯，我已经草拟了‘研究中可能误差来源’这一部分，但不确定你是否同意。

sentences.en: For example, the size of the sample, and whether it's big enough to make any general conclusions from
sentences.zh: 例如，样本量大小，以及它是否足够大，从而能得出任何普遍性结论。

sentences.en: But I thought actually we did have quite a big sample
sentences.zh: 但我后来觉得，其实我们的样本量已经相当大了。

sentences.en: COLIN: We did
sentences.zh: COLIN: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And our general method of observation seemed quite reliable
sentences.zh: 而且我们整体的观察方法似乎也相当可靠。

sentences.en: But we might not be all that accurate as far as the actual numbers go
sentences.zh: 但在具体数量方面，我们的准确性可能并不高。

sentences.en: HELEN: Yeah, we might have missed some organisms - if they were hiding under a rock, for example. wasn't sure about the way we described their habitats
sentences.zh: HELEN: 对，我们可能遗漏了一些生物——比如它们正躲在石头底下。另外，我对描述其栖息地的方式也不太确定。

sentences.en: I decided it was probably OK
sentences.zh: 我最后认为这样写应该没问题。

sentences.en: COLIN: Yeah, and the descriptions we gave of the smaller organisms, they weren't very detailed, but they were adequate in this context
sentences.zh: COLIN: 对，而且我们对小型生物的描述虽不够详尽，但在本研究背景下已属充分。

sentences.en: I'm not sure we identified all the species correctly though
sentences.zh: 不过，我不能确定我们是否正确识别了所有物种。

sentences.en: HELEN: OK, we'd better mention that
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的，那我们最好提一下这一点。

sentences.en: Now, how
sentences.zh: 现在，如何
